description: Built and operated a product design studio from zero — acquiring clients, leading projects end-to-end, and growing a portfolio spanning healthcare, fintech, AI, and enterprise SaaS. Developed a "Design-Led Development" methodology that compressed time-to-ship by aligning UX, engineering, and business goals from day one. Clients include the WHO, Accenture, Chili's, Teachable, Orkin, and Mount Sinai.

Owned product design vision, UX strategy, and UI execution for FlutterFlow's visual development platform — a no-code/low-code builder used by millions of developers and designers worldwide.Grew platform to 2.3M+ user signups over 3.5 years through product-led design decisions.

Led product design across CardFree's suite of contactless ordering and payments products for hospitality and venue clients. Designed multi-platform experiences (iOS, Android, web) balancing speed, simplicity, and high transaction volume constraints.

Led design sprints, user research, and rapid prototyping for early-stage startups in healthcare and fintech. Focused on MVP-first strategies to accelerate product-market fit. Collaborated with Google and Flutter teams on showcase products for Google I/O and Cloud Next.
